meta.about: Content for the choose-welcome proposals: the Welcome space of the Choose room (choose-room CR-11, CR-12, CR-13, CR-24, CR-90; frame RS-11, RS-12, RS-20; Learn baseline welcome-gallery WG-1 to WG-14). Not real data: products are placeholders (Printer A…) on purpose, as in choose-board. Every proposal reads this file through choose-welcome-data.js and assets/welcome-kit.js.
meta.settings: the Settings values Welcome reads (CR-90 and Provider): country and currency of the Choose room, useWeb, the room's default tone, the Provider default model and the model list (SE-48). Welcome never writes them.
meta.copy: fixed strings. question = the field's placeholder (CR-12); directionPlaceholder and example are proposals for this design, the rest follow WG-9/WG-10/WG-12/WG-13/WG-14 rewritten for Choose. {currency} is replaced by settings.currencySymbol.
meta.starters: need starters some proposals offer next to the direction: label = what the chip shows, insert = the text it adds at the cursor (a label only; the user writes the value, the app never writes the answer, as WG-11). They map to CR-30's needs.
meta.subjects: Choose subjects, newest last-opened first. id; title (1 to 120 characters, CR-12/WG-3); status exploring | decided | bought (CR-24); needs {answered,total}; criteria {must,nice,irrelevant,open} (CR-21); shortlisted (count); pick: the chosen product name, null while exploring (CR-22); missing: what the board still lists before a decision (CR-61 rule, from choose-board), empty when complete; lastOpened: relative text (WG-5 rule) with lastOpenedExact for the tooltip; createdAt; direction: what the user typed on Welcome, or empty. price: the chosen product's price as last seen, for the pick line (choose-gallery), null without a pick.
meta.scenarios: one per state the proposals must draw: subjects = ids shown as recents (at most 3, WG-6); total = all Choose subjects (Browse all n); cli = provider ready; library = library folder available (RS-41). first run: no subjects, Gallery and the subject spaces disabled (RS-11).
meta.hardCases: decided (sofa, long title), bought (printer), exploring with a long missing list (headphones, 118-character title), a brand-new subject with nothing settled (car), a subject with a direction and one without, CLI not ready, library unavailable, first run, a single subject, and the direction's 500-character limit (WG-9).
